questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. Digital currencies operate on decentralized blockchain technology, enabling secure, transparent, and near-instantaneous transactions across borders. B. On the other hand, the decentralized nature of these currencies challenges the traditional banking model, potentially diminishing the intermediaries' role. C. This disruptive shift poses both challenges and opportunities for traditional banking institutions. D. Financial institutions are compelled to adapt their strategies to incorporate the benefits of digital currencies while navigating regulatory uncertainties and addressing concerns related to security and volatility. E. On one hand, digital currencies offer the promise of financial inclusion, reduced transaction costs, and increased efficiency.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Digital currencies operate on decentralized blockchain technology, enabling secure, transparent, and near-instantaneous transactions across borders.

B. On the other hand, the decentralized nature of these currencies challenges the traditional banking model, potentially diminishing the intermediaries' role.

C. This disruptive shift poses both challenges and opportunities for traditional banking institutions.

D. Financial institutions are compelled to adapt their strategies to incorporate the benefits of digital currencies while navigating regulatory uncertainties and addressing concerns related to security and volatility.

E. On one hand, digital currencies offer the promise of financial inclusion, reduced transaction costs, and increased efficiency.
questions.solution:
Sentence A: This sentence introduces the central theme of digital currencies and their operation on decentralized blockchain technology.

Sentence C: Sentence C follows A to explain the impact of digital currencies on traditional banking institutions, emphasizing the disruptive nature of the shift.

Sentence E: Sentence E provides a contrast by presenting the positive aspects of digital currencies, indicating that they are not only disruptive but also carry potential benefits.

Sentence B: Following the positive aspects mentioned in Sentence E, Sentence B introduces the challenges posed to the traditional banking model by the decentralized nature of digital currencies.

Sentence D: The final sentence, D, concludes the paragraph by highlighting the actions that financial institutions must take in response to the challenges and opportunities presented by digital currencies.

Therefore, the correct sequence is ACEBD, making option (b) the correct answer.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. As a discipline that celebrates individuality and self-expression, fashion designing remains vibrant. B. The ever-evolving nature of fashion demands designers to stay attuned to emerging trends, technological advancements, and sustainable practices. C. Beyond the runway, these visionaries shape the commercial landscape, influencing retail and marketing strategies. D. From haute couture to ready-to-wear, fashion designers cater to diverse tastes and lifestyles, contributing to the rich tapestry of global style. E. Fashion designing is not merely about clothing; it's a form of artistic expression that reflects and responds to the cultural zeitgeist, making it an integral and continually evolving aspect of our lives.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. As a discipline that celebrates individuality and self-expression, fashion designing remains vibrant.

B. The ever-evolving nature of fashion demands designers to stay attuned to emerging trends, technological advancements, and sustainable practices.

C. Beyond the runway, these visionaries shape the commercial landscape, influencing retail and marketing strategies.

D. From haute couture to ready-to-wear, fashion designers cater to diverse tastes and lifestyles, contributing to the rich tapestry of global style.

E. Fashion designing is not merely about clothing; it's a form of artistic expression that reflects and responds to the cultural zeitgeist, making it an integral and continually evolving aspect of our lives.
questions.solution: B introduces the idea that fashion is constantly changing, and designers need to keep up with various factors. It sets the stage for discussing the role of fashion designers in the industry. Following the introduction of the dynamic nature of fashion, D elaborates on the diverse range of styles and tastes that fashion designers cater to. It expands on the idea introduced in sentence B. Now, in C, the focus shifts from the creative aspect of fashion to its commercial impact. Fashion designers are not just artists; they also play a crucial role in shaping the business and marketing aspects of the industry. E further emphasizes the artistic and cultural significance of fashion designing. It completes the narrative by connecting fashion to broader cultural contexts, suggesting its integral role in our lives. The final sentence, A serves as a concluding statement, summarizing the overall theme. It brings the focus back to the creative aspect of fashion, emphasizing its vibrant and individualistic nature. So, the correct order is BDCEA, as it follows a logical progression from the dynamic nature of fashion to the diverse style designers cater to, their commercial impact, the artistic expression in fashion, and finally, a concluding statement on the vibrancy of fashion as a discipline. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

The remaining sentence A is the last part of the sentence as it states that the introduction of a device that could potentially be used on an opposing country escalated tensions between two major powerful countries.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.questionHtml:

B. That day was no exception.

C. She would wear the same colour clothing every day and would follow the same daily routine.

D. It was the first sound that Ms. Mary would wake up to every morning.

questions.solution:

questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, the 1st and the last part of the sentences/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/ passage is split into four parts and named P, Q, R and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentences/passage and find out which of the four combinations is correct.

1. "Just hang it there," she said, "and let me help you with your coat."

P. There were no umbrellas, no walking sticks - nothing.

Q. There were no other hats or coats in the hall.

R. "We have it all to ourselves," she said, smiling at him over her shoulder.

S. "You see, it isn't very often I have the pleasure of taking a visitor into my little nest."

6. She then led the way upstairs.
questions.solution: The passage begins with 1, telling us that the speaker wished to help the listener with his coat. Q and P follow as a pair: Q tells us that there were no other hats or coats. P continues along the same lines. R gives the response of the speaker to this. S continues the conversation. 6 concludes the passage by telling us what the speaker did next. QPRS is the final order.
